# WAD entry names

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/wad-names.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The file names recovered for `WARRIORS.WAD`'s entries. The archive stores only a CRC-32 of
`./ee_files/<name>` ([WARRIORS.DIR](../research/formats/wad-dir.md)), so a name is known once a candidate
string hashes to an entry. Each name here was checked against its hash.

!!! info "What is complete"

    6,313 of 10,701 names are known; the streamed world and most early entries are still unnamed.

6,313 entries. Data: `research/references/wad-names.yaml`.

## Sources and evidence

Evidence levels used: confirmed-code.

- name recovery (coney-tools wad recover-names and the WAD survey)

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `crc` | hex | | The entry's hash in WARRIORS.DIR: CRC-32 of `./ee_files/<name>`, lower case. |
| `name` | str | | The recovered name. |
| `kind` | str | | The name's extension ([WAD contents](../research/formats/wad-contents.md)). |
| `index` | int | | The entry's position in WARRIORS.DIR (stable for the NTSC-U disc). |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-evidence.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
